literal: By the proper method not strived-for undertaking, many standing even if they guard, ruined with holes will become.
translation: An undertaking that is not carried out through the proper method will fail and fall to pieces, even if many people stand together to guard and support it.
modern: முறையான வழியில் முயற்சி செய்யாத ஒரு செயலை, பலர் ஒன்று கூடிப் பாதுகாத்தாலும் அது தோல்வியடைந்து அழியும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that the correct method (ஆறு) is essential for the success of any undertaking. An effort (வருத்தம்) that is not executed through the right systematic path (ஆற்றின் வருந்தா) is fundamentally flawed. Even if a large group of people stand together (பலர் நின்று) to protect and support it (போற்றினும்), the project will eventually develop leaks and collapse (பொத்துப்படும்). Success depends entirely on the soundness of the plan and method, not on the sheer number of supporters trying to save a flawed execution.
